name: Kaela Shadowspear
summary: Southwest of Windshear Crag, Kaela Shadowspear watches the Stonetalon wilderness as tensions rise. She works with fellow sentinels while new disruptions trouble the land.

sections.title: A Scout on the Frontier
sections.body: Kaela Shadowspear watches the passes southwest of Windshear Crag. The Horde presses into the Stonetalon Mountains, while goblin operations exploit the land's natural bounty. Beside Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome, she tracks threats reaching farther into night elf ancestral territory.

sections.title: Healing the Land
sections.body: Violence against nature has stirred the elementals and harmed the forest's ancient guardians. Kaela sends travelers to face the raging spirits and seeks what has corrupted the wounded treants who once guarded the Vale. She strives to restore peace before the land is scarred beyond repair.

faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf sentinel at a frontier camp southwest of Windshear Crag. She oversees scouting and helps protect local wildlife and spirits.

faq.q: Where can Kaela Shadowspear be found?
faq.answer: Kaela is in a small Alliance camp southwest of Windshear Crag, along the road through the Stonetalon Mountains. Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer, shares the camp.
Kaela coordinates with Sentinel Thenysil. They exchange intelligence on enemy movements and local threats across Stonetalon.

faq.q: Why is Kaela concerned about the elementals?
faq.answer: The Venture Co. set the Charred Vale aflame and tore at it with machines. Flame and stone spirits, along with spirits of rage, were roused; Kaela wants their numbers reduced so the land can recover.

faq.q: What is happening to the ancients near Windshear Crag?
faq.answer: The treants who protect the Charred Vale helped drive back the Venture Co., but they have since become corrupt. Gaxim suspects the goblins' weapons are to blame, so Kaela asks travelers to bring him a piece of corroded shrapnel from a wounded treant for study.

faq.q: Why is a gnome stationed with Kaela?
faq.answer: Kaela shares her camp with Gaxim Rustfizzle, an Alliance gnome. She tends to the wilderness's spiritual and tactical balance, while Gaxim works against the hostile goblin machinery and operations nearby.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you can bring Kaela intelligence from Stonetalon's contested reaches and help coordinate it between distant outposts.
As a night elf, you know the need to defend sacred ground. Kaela works to soothe outraged spirits and protect Kalimdor's revered ancients.
As a druid, you can help Kaela uncover what corrupted the Vale's ancients and ease the pain of its disturbed nature spirits.
